ov: الدنيا بعينيكَ (الإنجليزية: Call Me by Your Name) هو فلم دراما رومنسي للمراهقين تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وإيطاليا وصدر في سنة 2017. الفلم من إخراج الإيطالي لوكا غواداغنينو ومن بطولة أرمي هامر وتيموثي تشالاميت وأميرة قصار. الفلم مأخوذ عن رواية تحمل نفس الاسم للكاتب أندريه أسيمان وأعاد كتابة سيناريو الفلم الكاتب جيمس أيفوري. وهذا الفلم هو النسخة الأخيرة من مجموعة أفلام تضم فلم أنا أحب (2009) وفلم دفقة كبيرة (2015).
plotEn:
In the summer of 1983, Elio Perlman, a 17-year-old Jewish American-French-Italian boy, lives with his parents in rural Northern Italy. Elio's father, a professor of archaeology, invites a 24-year-old Jewish-American graduate student, Oliver, to live with the family over the summer and help with his academic paperwork. Elio, an introspective bookworm and musician, initially thinks he has little in common with Oliver, who appears confident and carefree. Elio spends much of the summer reading, playing piano, and hanging out with his childhood friends, Chiara and Marzia. During a volleyball match, Oliver touches Elio's back, but Elio brushes it off. Elio later finds himself jealous upon seeing Oliver kiss Chiara.
Elio and Oliver spend more time together, taking long walks into town, and accompanying Elio's father on an archaeological trip. Elio is increasingly drawn to Oliver, even sneaking into Oliver's room to smell his clothing. Elio eventually confesses his feelings to Oliver, who tells him they cannot discuss such things. Later, in a secluded spot, the two kiss for the first time. Oliver is reluctant to take things further, and they do not speak for several days.
Elio goes on a date with Marzia and the two have sex. Elio leaves a note for Oliver to end their silence. Oliver writes back, asking Elio to meet him at midnight.
